prompt: Create an unedited documentary-style photograph shot from inside a stopped train, looking out through the open train doorway at a rural Japanese station platform. The right edge of the frame is dominated by the beige interior train door frame and a dark vertical rubber seal, slightly out of focus, creating a candid passenger point of view. Center-left stands an elderly Japanese man, full body visible from head to below the knees, facing the camera with a calm, slightly tired, unsmiling expression and natural facial asymmetry. He has short thinning gray hair, a weathered face, and wears a short-sleeve muted plaid button-up shirt, gray pleated trousers, a black belt, and a wristwatch. His left hand is raised in a gentle farewell wave with open palm and five visible fingers, while his right hand holds a semi-transparent white plastic shopping bag hanging at his side. The station platform has gray concrete flooring, tactile yellow paving strips, a low dark retaining wall, train tracks behind him, white support columns, and a simple roof structure overhead. In the background are small countryside houses, utility poles, lush green hills and mountains, and a cloudy bright daytime sky. Use professional natural-light travel photography: realistic lens perspective, soft daylight, balanced exposure, subtle depth of field, muted colors, no beautification, no retouching, no cinematic color grading, no text, no watermark.
